answer: Each identity must lock a 400-token bond and prove one hardware credential, logged by validators at the trellis registry. A sybil attempt locks 400 tokens per identity, forfeits 100 percent of bond on proven fraud, and waits two epochs for withdrawal. Copying or splitting identities fails because each fake adds marginal cost, the bond is slashed as a shared penalty, and independent jurors cross-check each grove credential against a mirror of device logs.
